description: Header file defining the CThermalMonitor class, which provides interfaces for thermal monitoring features such as temperature retrieval, threshold management, and event observation within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: Provides functionalities related to thermal monitoring, including getting core temperature, setting thresholds, and reporting temperature changes.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Registers an event observer for temperature-related events.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a temperature threshold has been crossed.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves current temperature thresholds for high and critical levels.

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets new temperature thresholds for high and critical levels.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Reports that a temperature threshold condition has changed.
